test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If 21st March 2021 was a Sunday, then what will be the day on 12th January 2022?
solution:
**Given : **21st March 2021 was a Sunday.

 
• Total number of days in a normal year = 365 
 
• Number of odd days in a normal year = 365/7 = 1 
 
• Total number of days in a leap year = 366
 
• Number of odd days in a leap year = 366/7 = 2 
 
• Total number of days from 21st March 2021 to 12th January 2022 = 10(March) + 30(April) + 31(May) + 30(June) + 31(July) + 31(August) + 30(September) + 31(October) + 30(November) + 31(December) + 12(January) = 297** **
 
• Since, it was Sunday on 21st March 2021, every 7th day from 21st March will be a Sunday.
 
• Thus, no. of odd days from 21st March 2021 to 12th January 2022 = 297/7 = **3**
 
• Now, 21st March 2021 + 3 odd days = 12th January 2022 ( Wednesday)
 
• Thus, 12th January 2022 will be **Wednesday**.

Hence, "option 1" is the correct answer.
